data.description:
## Problem
Once aggregation, review-bot/CLI rendering, and the workflow gate no longer read `severity`
(prior sibling tickets), the field itself should be removed from the finding shape per the
ADR decision -- `findings.py`'s `SEVERITIES` vocabulary, `normalize_finding`'s
clamp-to-"info" behavior, the `Finding.severity` Pydantic field, `common.schema.json`'s
`$defs/finding.severity` (a REQUIRED field there, referenced by `completion_verdict.schema.json`
and `review_result.schema.json` -- this is the one documented BREAKING schema change), and the
now-fully-vestigial `BLOCKING_SEVERITIES`/`blocking_severities` config in
`review_bot/config.py` (already unused in the current `code_review_decision` flow per
`adapter.py`'s own docstring).

## Approach
1. Remove `severity` from `pass3_decide`'s emitted finding dict (`review_kernel/decide.py`) --
   keep `severity_label()` itself as an internal impact-bucketing helper (still used by
   calibration/eval code and `test_divergence_grade_split.py`), just stop stamping its output
   into the finding.
2. Remove `SEVERITIES`, the severity clamp in `normalize_finding`, and the `Finding.severity`
   Pydantic field from `findings.py`.
3. Make `severity` non-required then remove it from `common.schema.json`'s `$defs/finding`
   (delete the `$defs/severity` def once nothing references it).
4. Remove `DEFAULT_BLOCKING_SEVERITIES`/`blocking_severities` from `review_bot/config.py` and
   its env-var registration.
5. Add the one required BREAKING entry to `docs/release-notes.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`
   documenting the `finding.severity` field removal from `completion_verdict` and
   `review_result`, per `docs/api-stability.md`'s policy for required-field removal.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `grep -rn '"severity"' src/rebar/llm/findings.py src/rebar/llm/review_kernel/decide.py`
  finds no finding-shape references (historical comments/docstrings are acceptable).
- [ ] `common.schema.json`'s `$defs/finding.required` no longer lists `severity`.
- [ ] `review_bot/config.py` has no `blocking_severities`/`BLOCKING_SEVERITIES` symbol; the
  matching tests in `tests/unit/test_review_bot.py` and `tests/unit/test_gen_env_registry.py`
  are removed or updated to assert the symbol's absence.
- [ ] `docs/release-notes.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` each have a new BREAKING entry naming the
  `finding.severity` removal from `completion_verdict`/`review_result`.
- [ ] `make test` passes with the full suite -- no remaining test constructs a finding via
  `severity=` and expects it to round-trip.

## Testing
Tier: in-process unit tests (schema validation against a finding dict with no `severity` key
passes `common.schema.json`'s finding validator) plus a contract test (`pass3_decide`'s real
output fed to the schema validator). Oracle: schema validation succeeds without `severity`;
`severity_label()` remains importable and correct for its retained calibration/eval callers --
existing `test_severity_label_buckets`/`test_divergence_grade_split.py` tests keep passing
unchanged, proving the helper's own behavior is untouched even though it is decoupled from
the Finding shape.
data.title: Drop the severity field from the finding shape (BREAKING)
